mainEntity.name: What makes Formester form management software different from a form builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Form builders focus on making one form. Form management software focuses on operating a library of forms at scale: multiple team members, role-based access, workflow rules, submission routing, centralized reporting, API access. Formester ships both: the builder for creating forms and the management layer (Workspaces, roles, rules, API) for running them at team scale.

mainEntity.name: How does Formester compare to Formstack for form management?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formstack starts at $50/user/month and adds up quickly at 5+ seats. Formester's Business plan is $49/month TOTAL for 25 team seats, unlimited forms, unlimited responses, workflow rules, and API access. Formstack ships HIPAA compliance and PCI Level 1 as its main differentiator. If HIPAA or PCI Level 1 is a hard requirement, Formstack. Everything else, Formester at 5-10% of the cost.

Yes. Formester's free plan has unlimited forms and unlimited responses. No trial. No credit card. Native payment collection, AI form generator, custom email notifications, quiz auto-scoring, and drop-off analytics all included on free. Paid plans (Personal $13/mo, Business $49/mo) unlock branding removal, conditional logic, API access, team seats, and PDF export.

Not today. Formester is hosted only. If self-hosting is a hard requirement (data sovereignty, air-gapped networks), Form.io ships a self-hostable version. Formester's hosted infrastructure is on AWS with GDPR-compliant regional hosting available.

mainEntity.name: How does Formester's MCP server work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Point Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI client at Formester's MCP server URL. The AI can then create forms, list forms, fetch submissions, and update forms using your Formester API credentials. Same permissions as your account. Ideal for teams that want to author forms from a chat interface.

Formester ships native rules: route submissions by field value, tag by source, notify the right owner, escalate by threshold. For deeper workflows (multi-step approvals, external system triggers, complex branching), use the native Zapier integration (500+ apps) or webhooks.

mainEntity.name: Is Formester SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA certified?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. If SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, or HIPAA is a procurement requirement, use Formstack Enterprise or Jotform Enterprise. Formester's certifications roadmap is not public today.

mainEntity.name: Can I migrate from Jotform or Google Forms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Export existing forms and responses as CSV from Jotform or Google Forms. In Formester, either paste the question list into the AI generator to rebuild the form structure, or import responses directly. Most single-form migrations finish in under 30 minutes.
Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack, Stripe, PayPal, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Zapier (500+ downstream apps). REST API v2 and webhooks for anything custom. MCP server for AI agents.

How it works

Three ways to build any form your team needs

From IT tickets to vendor NDAs to customer feedback. Every route ends in a shareable form that plugs into your workflow and your stack.

Start from a template

Pick from 500+ templates: contact, intake, feedback, event registration, employee request, vendor NDA, and more. Edit and publish in minutes.

Best when the shape is standard and you need something team-ready fast.

Generate with AI

Prompt: "An IT request form that captures issue type, priority, affected department, and screenshot upload with autoresponder." Or paste your own paragraph. The AI picks the field types, wires the routing, and ships in 30 seconds.

Digitize your paper PDF

Upload any paper form your team is currently emailing around. The AI reads the PDF, extracts every field, and rebuilds it as a shareable web form ready for centralized management. Two clicks to modernize a paper process.

Signature validity

Every submission stays organized, auditable, and connected

A form submission that lives in a spreadsheet is a form submission you'll lose track of. Form management software fixes that: centralized library, role-based access, workflow rules that route submissions to the right owner, and an audit trail on every response.

Formester centralizes every form in Workspaces, gives you admin/editor/viewer roles, and stamps every submission with IP, timestamp, user-agent, and submitter identity. Available as a CSV, JSON, or PDF export on Business. GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant.

What gets captured on every submission

Five layers of proof, on by default

  • Native e-signature drawn or typed, stored as a vector alongside the raw signature image.
  • Signer identity captured alongside the signature: full name, email, and any other fields you added.
  • Exact timestamp down to the second, in UTC, on every signature.
  • PDF export of every signed consent, on Business and above, so records can be shared with legal, HR, or a client.
  • GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA compliant storage. Encryption at rest and in transit. We never share or train on your consent data (DPA §4.4).

itemList.description: Import existing forms (from Google Forms, Typeform, Jotform, or paper PDFs) into a single Workspace. Organize by department, project, or use case.

itemList.title: Set team roles and workflow rules
itemList.description: Invite team members with admin, editor, or viewer roles. Set workflow rules: route submissions by field value, notify the right owner, escalate by threshold, tag by source.

itemList.title: Route submissions via API, webhook, or integration
itemList.description: Push every submission to Slack, Zapier, your CRM, your ticket system, or your database via REST API. MCP server lets AI agents author and query forms directly.

components.markup:
See it in action

Formester's form management platform, actually working

Real product screens. No mockups, no fake data. Every clip is from app.formester.com.

Six ways to create a form

AI prompt, template, scratch, PDF import, backend form, or import from another platform. Pick the shape that fits how you work.

Form builder with live design controls

Drag and drop fields onto the canvas. Change theme, colors, and typography from the right panel. Every change shows on the form in real time.

Ready-made template library

Start from IT request, feedback, onboarding, vendor NDA, or any of 500+ templates. Search, filter, publish in minutes.

Form-to-PDF export

Every submission renders to a downloadable PDF. Push to Google Drive, Slack, or any DMS via API and webhooks.

The form layer for every team in your company

HR, Ops, Finance, Support, Compliance, Product, Marketing. One platform, one form library, one integration per system.

HR and People Ops

Onboarding, benefits enrolment, PTO requests, exit interviews. Route by department, hide fields by role.

Operations

Vendor intake, purchase requests, facility tickets, project intake. Rule-based routing to the right owner.

Finance

Expense claims, reimbursement requests, budget approvals, vendor payment setup. Threshold-based approval routing to the right approver.

Generate Quizzes in Seconds →

Customer Support

Bug reports, feature requests, VIP escalations. Route by priority or customer tier to the right queue with SLA rules.

Researchers

Participant informed-consent for survey studies, user interviews, and product research. Capture the signed consent alongside the study screener in one submission.

Analyze Customer Feedback →

Schools and colleges

Field trip permission slips, media release for student photos, athletics participation waivers, technology use agreements. Parent name and student name captured on the same signed submission.

Generate Surveys with AI in Seconds →

Event organizers

Liability waivers for attendees, photo and video release for the event coverage, allergen and dietary consent for catered events, minor participation forms with parent signature.

Nonprofits

Volunteer liability waivers, donor recognition consent for annual reports, program participation acknowledgements. Free plan handles unlimited signed consents at $0.

For developers

Your submissions, ready for the CRM you already use

Every Formester form ships with a REST API and an MCP server, so submissions don't stop at a CSV. Pipe leads into your agent. Stream applications into your hiring copilot. Nobody else on this list ships MCP.

MCP server

Plug Formester into Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible model

Claude ChatGPT Custom agents

Connect Formester to any MCP-compatible model and let it read your signed consent records directly. Ask Claude "which high-priority IT requests from this week are still open past their SLA?" or have a custom agent flag any high-value sales lead submission that meets qualification criteria so your AE gets paged immediately.

Read the MCP docs →
REST API v2

Or build directly on the REST API

Self-service token Webhooks Business plan +

Pull signed consent records into your CRM or data warehouse, log the timestamp to your compliance system, or push pre-filled consent URLs back from Salesforce. Self-service token at app.formester.com/api in two clicks. No support ticket, no waiting.

Read the API docs →

Privacy and data ownership

Your consent records belong to you. We don't train on them

When you upload a PDF, paste a prompt, or generate a form, that content is used to generate your form and nothing else. Per Section 4.4 of our DPA, Formester does not use Customer Data for analytics, advertising, marketing, or product training. The Google Gemini integration we use to power AI features inherits the same boundary.

Encrypted in transit and at rest, hosted on Heroku and AWS, automated encrypted backups with a 90-day retention, and full data deletion on request. We are GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. We are not SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified yet, and we will tell you so directly rather than dance around it.

What's in the DPA
"Formester does not use Customer Data for analytics, advertising, marketing, or product training."

Section 4.4, Formester Data Processing Agreement, effective January 2026.

Read the DPA → Security overview →

Unlock the full power of Formester

The features that make Formester the practical form management platform for growing teams.

Workspaces and team seats

Group forms by department. 25 team members on Business, unlimited on Enterprise. Admin, editor, viewer roles built in.

Workflow rules and routing

Route submissions by field value: high-priority requests to the on-call, sales leads to the AE, expense claims to the right approver.

PDF export and submission storage

Every submission stored, exportable as CSV, JSON, or PDF. 50 GB file storage on Business, custom on Enterprise.

Native REST API and MCP

Full CRUD API for forms, submissions, and webhooks. MCP server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other AI clients.

Form translations

Multi-language forms with a single source-of-truth. Ship the same form in English, Spanish, French, or any language your team needs.

Integrations

Native: Google Drive, Sheets, Slack, Stripe, PayPal, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier (500+ apps). Webhooks for anything custom.
